description: Search the WHOLE Adaga network at once for a stay: fans out to every matching establishment and returns real-time availability with exact total prices (euro cents), sorted by price — like Booking.com but machine-native, at the establishments' exact direct prices (no OTA markup, no commission passed to the traveler). Workflow: (1) call this, (2) pick an offer (tenant_slug + room_id), (3) call network_book with traveler name and email, (4) hand the payment instructions to the human. Constraints: dates YYYY-MM-DD, checkin < checkout, checkin not in the past, max 30 nights. A tenant that does not answer within 6 s is skipped (reported in errors). No authentication required, no rate limit, no pagination — all matching offers are returned in one response (bounded by the number of active establishments).

city.description: Filter by city (e.g. Luxembourg); omit to search everywhere

max_total_cents.description: Budget cap for the whole stay, in euro cents

name: network_search
